title: Employ only registered teachers
what: Employ or engage a person to teach only if the person is registered, holds a limited authority or is directly supervised by a registered teacher.

sources.title: Teachers Registration Act 2000 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not employ or engage a person to teach if that person is not a registered teacher, is not the holder of a limited authority or is not under the direct supervision of a registered teacher.
